claims: Paul Thomas Anderson won the 2026 Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay for One Battle After Another.
One Battle After Another is a loose adaptation of Thomas Pynchon’s 1990 novel Vineland.
One Battle After Another won the 2026 Oscar for Best Picture.
One Battle After Another won the 2026 Oscar for Best Director.
One Battle After Another centers on a former revolutionary and his daughter.
Bugonia by Will Tracy was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay.
Frankenstein by Guillermo del Toro was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay.
Hamnet by Chloé Zhao and Maggie O'Farrell was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay.
Train Dreams by Clint Bentley and Greg Kwedar was nominated for the 2026 Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay.
One Battle After Another won the adapted screenplay award at the 2026 BAFTA Film Awards.
